fields.unlimitedAmmo: MW2's consumers. SHELL: mission_result_sub_023890 does not advance missionIndex when it is 1
fields.invulnerability: MW2's consumers. SHELL: blocks mission advancement when 1, like unlimitedAmmo
fields.collisionDamage: MW2's consumers. SHELL: blocks mission advancement when 0. So a result of 2 only counts toward the campaign with unlimited ammo off, invulnerability off and collision damage on
fields.heatTracking: MW2's consumers. SHELL: mission_result_sub_023890 awards rank points on a Trial only when it is 1, besides the three advancement conditions
fields.difficulty: 0..2, MW2's mech_config armour scaling. SHELL: star_files_write reads it from its own copy of the file. 0 moves the enemy AI skill rows one easier and 2 one harder

fields.directory: the type's directory once loaded; project_resource_size and project_read_resource load all of them when it is null
fields.field_0x4: only project_file_close touches it (frees it when non-null)

fields.offset: file offset of the record; project_read_resource seeks to offset + the type's recordPrefix
fields.length: the record's length including that prefix: project_resource_size returns length - recordPrefix

fields.item: an item code (weapon id, 6001 + n heat sink, 7001 + n jump jet, ammo ...); -1 empty
fields.criticals: slots it still needs: the item type's criticals, designHeatSinkType for a heat sink, 1 for a jump jet or ammo

fields.scenario: the mission's *SCN1 stream name (yellSCN1 ...); main's state 0xb loads it for pilots_sub_0291b0. NULL in the closing 'Retired' row
fields.isTrial: 1 on exactly the rows titled 'Trial 1'..'Trial 4' (missions 4, 8, 11, 15 of both careers); trials_sub_037a50 and mission_result_sub_023890 test it == 1
fields.title: the mission's display name (Pyre Light, ..., Trial 4, Retired)

fields.mass: hundredths of a ton, halved for XL (designEngineMass)

fields.number: the device's position in the giddi list, -1 none
fields.name: InputDevice.name; the name temp.map entries print

fields.member: which star member stands here (0 the player)
fields.spriteX: where star_slot_draw plays the member's chassis sprite; the double-click box is x +-50
fields.spriteY: the box is the 100 px above
fields.panel: which of the three panels (label position, CHANGE MECH button 6 + panel) shows this member

fields.internal: structureTable's value for the location (head 3); the save writes it to MechSection.internal
fields.maxArmour: front + rear may not exceed it: the ARMOR panel's +1 buttons test it, and the location rows print it as 'Head (9)'. The loader sets 2 x internal (head 9). (Was left unnamed: 'no reader has been found' until the ARMOR handlers were recovered.)
fields.armourFront: points on the front; saved to MechSection.armorFront, stripped by mechlab_trim_armour_to_tonnage
fields.armourRear: points on the rear, -1 for a location without rear armour (all but the torsos 1..3); the trim and the allocated sum skip -1

fields.tag: the resource type ('TABL', 'MEK�' ...); project_find_type compares 4 bytes
fields.dirOffset: file offset of the type's directory; project_load_directories skips the type when 0
fields.dirSize: the directory's size: project_load_directories allocates and reads this much
fields.recordPrefix: bytes skipped at the start of each record (62, the DATA record header, in MW2.PRJ): added to the offset and taken off the length

fields.kind: 0 an axis control on an axis, 2 an axis control on two buttons (input minus, input2 plus in temp.map), 1 a button control; controls_clear_bindings gives controls 0..6 kind 0
fields.flags: bits 0..2 the modifier (1 Ctrl, 2 Alt, 4 Shift); bit 31 a reversed axis; bits 4..6 only while controls_write_temp_map runs
fields.flags2: input2's flags, built and cleared by controls_write_temp_map

fields.animCode: 2 letters ('ds' Firemoth, 'kf', 'jn' ...): screen_mechlab builds the chassis animation name from it with the career's 'awomp%s' / 'ajfmp%s' / 'aiamp%s' format. Its reader appeared once the table was typed from 0x83678
fields.prefix: 3 letters matched against a MEK name (star_set_member, star_bwd_add_mech)
fields.streamName: the chassis stream star_bwd_add_mech writes at GPS +0x24 (firemoth ...)
fields.displayName: drawn on the star screen (Firemoth, Kit Fox ...)
fields.tonnage: star_set_member refuses a chassis above the Keshik maximum by it, and the star screen shows it as '%d.00 T'. Resolves the 'no consumer' note from the first star-files increment
fields.nameSound: a DATABASE.MW2 WAV item (83..99; -1 for the Tarantula): screen_mechlab loads it as a sample (0xa6370) whenever NEXT / PREV CHASSIS changes the chassis. (Was '+0x10: no consumer read yet' when the table was typed 4 bytes late.)

fields.field_0x0: not read (an INDX chunk header in MW2.PRJ - see MW2's ProjectDirectory)
fields.entries: indexed directly by resource id (declared [1]; ids start at 1)

fields.chassis: index into chassisTable, set by star_set_member; star_files_write skips a member with -1
fields.mekName: star_set_member strncpys 8 and NUL-terminates at +0xc; star_bwd_add_mech writes it into the GPS chunk
fields.pilotName: star_set_member copies it; star_bwd_add_mech takes 15 characters

fields.field_0x0: not checked (project_file_open checks 'PROJ' at file offset 0, before this buffer)
fields.length: length - 8: project_file_open reads it at file offset 0x10 and allocates length + 8

fields.mass: hundredths of a ton; summed into designWeaponMass. (Was described as the table at 0x7faa4 +0.)
fields.criticals: slots the item takes; WEAPON INFO 'Crit'
fields.ammoPerTon: non-zero for an ammo weapon (the adds test it); the value is the shots per ton (6 for LRM 20, 24 for LRM 5); WEAPON INFO 'Ammo'
fields.name: 'LRM 20' ...; WEAPON INFO 'Type' and the WEAPONS TABLE rows

fields.armorFront: mechlab_load_mek sums it into designArmourPoints and copies it to designLocations[].armourFront; the save writes it back
fields.armorRear: the same, into armourRear for the three torsos (1..3)
fields.internal: not read by the shell: the save WRITES designLocations[].internal here, from structureTable
fields.slots: item codes; the loader copies them into designCriticals
fields.numSlots: how many of slots are used; the loader stops at it

fields.y: bit 31 set = relative (widget_panel_layout): previous y + ((y & 0xff0) >> 4) * previous h + (y & 0xf) - 0x80000022 two rows down plus 2 px. (Was 'how the panel reads that is not established'.)
fields.w: -1: taken from the drawn label's width (widget_panel_layout)
fields.h: -1: the drawn label's height, else the previous row's
fields.textStyle: passed as the label's last argument: 0xa5530 normal; draw functions swap in 0xa5630 for the selected row and 0xa5730 for Used Mass over the maximum
fields.label: the label the row's drawFn put up; mechlab_open_panel frees it and clears this
fields.value: a label's char * (mechlab_widget_draw_label), a WEAPON INFO field index or a weapon type index, by drawFn - so an int, not a pointer
fields.extra: a second value, by row: the CUSTOMIZING summary's component rows hold the address of the panel they open (mechlab_open_panel reads it); the EQUIPMENT rows hold an item code (5000, 5401 ...). An int for the same reason as value - typed as a pointer, the item codes became references to 0x1388 ... (first draft of this increment)

fields.w: the draw functions centre their text at x + w / 2
fields.textStyle: the mech lab's draw functions pass it as the label's last argument (0xa5530 normally; mechlab_draw_weapon_row swaps in 0xa5630 for the selected type); the options panel leaves it 0
fields.clickFn: options_click_*; the options panel calls it on a left click inside the row
fields.value: the byte or dword it shows and changes: a simOptions or soundConfig field

fields.succeeded: MW2: the objective reached state 5. SHELL: the promotion count in mission_result_sub_023890 tests it == 1
fields.category: MW2: 1 Primary, 2 Secondary, 8 Return, else Tertiary. SHELL: the promotion count tests it == 1, so only primaries count
fields.startedAt: MW2's writer; no shell consumer read yet
fields.changedAt: MW2's writer; no shell consumer read yet
fields.required: MW2: Objective.isPrerequisite (the 'M' flag). No shell consumer read yet
fields.text: MW2 strcpys the objective text here, and a longer one runs on into the next record

fields.inUse: 1 for a registered pilot, 0 for an empty slot: screen_register opens a name entry on 0 and sets 1 for a new pilot; DELETE MECHWARRIOR sets 0
fields.selected: the pilot last chosen: screen_register sets it on the clicked slot and clears it on the other nine, and on entry takes the in-use record with it set as currentPilot. It is saved in MW2REG.CFG, so the choice persists
fields.career: which campaign: indexes careerMissionTables (trials_sub_037a50, mission_result_sub_023890, which also tests it == 2 and never promotes that case; what a third value means is not established). 0 is Clan Wolf and 1 Jade Falcon: main's state 0xf plays mwoland for index 0 of the same table and mjfland otherwise. career_registry_load's reset gives slots 10..19 career 1 and slots 0..9 career 0
fields.missionIndex: the pilot's place in the campaign: careerMissionTables[career][missionIndex]. mission_result_sub_023890 adds 1 when the result is 2 and none of the three flags at 0x7d40c blocks it, and tests it against 0x10. 16 is past the last mission ('Retired')
fields.rank: rankTitles[rank] (the function at 0x1caa0): 0 Mechwarrior ... 8 Khan. mission_result_sub_023890 adds promotions to it and clamps it to 8
fields.careerHonor: screen_debriefing adds the mission's honor to it after a win (result 2) and prints it as 'Career Honor:'; orders_text_build substitutes it for \H. screen_register starts a new pilot at 1000 * (1 + rand() / 32767), 1000..2000. (Was unnamed: 'a per-mission amount, which total not established')
fields.killTally: screen_debriefing adds MissionTallies.enemyMechsDestroyed (the TOTAL column, whoever made the kill) and playerKillsEnemyOther (the player's DIRECT non-mech kills) - two different columns, as the code has it. Read by hall_of_honor_screen (Kills / Hit %); this said 'no reader yet' before
fields.enemyMechHits: screen_debriefing adds MissionTallies.enemyMechHits. Read by hall_of_honor_screen (Kills / Hit %); this said 'no reader yet' before
fields.shotsFired: screen_debriefing adds MissionTallies.shotsFired. Read by hall_of_honor_screen (Kills / Hit %); this said 'no reader yet' before
fields.pilotName: main passes it as the player's pilot name to star_select_sub_03a8a0. It is also compared against cheat words: FREEBIRTHTOAD (trials_sub_037a50), FERRARI (0x1c080), NOHERCSALLOWED (mission_result_sub_023890). 16 bytes because +0x38 is a separate field; how long the entry screen allows is not established

fields.videoDriver: '' (320x200), 'vesa480.dll' (640x480) or 'vesa768.dll' (1024x768); MW2's game_boot copies 12 characters into videoDriverName

fields.smk: the open Smacker movie (anim_open_smk); its header supplies width, height and frames
fields.shapes: the loaded VFX shape table (anim_open_shp); one shape per frame
fields.frameBuffer: a Smacker slot's decoded frame, which anim_update_all draws; anim_free frees it
fields.flags: anim_start's flags | 0x80000100. Read bits: 0x80000000 active (anim_start, anim_start_free); 0x80 anchor at the bottom-centre; 0x40 Smacker open flag 0x20; 0x10 restore the background when stopped; 0x02 no frame buffer; 0x10000000 apply the movie palette. From anim_update_all: 0x40000000 free after this pass; 0x20000000 follow the mouse; 0x100 changed since last drawn (picks one of two draw calls); 0x20 hidden; 0x10 drawn last pass, so its old rectangle is restored when it moves, changes frame or hides (REFINES 'restore the background when stopped'); 8 loop at the end; 4 hold the last frame; 1 stopped (set at the end, or by anim_set_flags)
fields.x: anim_start's x, moved left by width / 2 under flag 0x80
fields.y: anim_start's y, moved up by the height under flag 0x80
fields.prevX: where it was drawn last pass: the rectangle anim_update_all restores
fields.prevFrame: the frame drawn last pass; anim_set_frame sets -1 to force a redraw
fields.frameCount: the end test for looping, holding or stopping
fields.frameInterval: 1000 / rate (anim_start; rate 0 means 10), added to nextFrameTime
fields.nextFrameTime: a shape animation advances when timer_read() reaches it

fields.font: the font holder: text_width and the character drawer take it
fields.baseColour: restored into currentColour at a space or a backslash code
fields.currentColour: \A sets it to 0x84240 (textRemap1, ink -> colour 1) for one word. Which draw call reads it has not been seen - the character drawer is passed only font, x and y
fields.typewriter: 1: text_label_redraw replays character by character; otherwise it draws the whole string at once
fields.text: the label's own copy of its text, codes included
fields.width: text_width at creation, widened by typing to the pen's reach
fields.x: left edge; the origin for \G columns and tab stops
fields.done: set when typing reaches the end; text_label_type_step then returns 1
fields.penX: where the next character is drawn; \G, \B and \T move it
fields.charIndex: the next character to type; -1 before the first

fields.name: the DLL's file name without '.dll' ('keyboard' ...)
fields.driver: the loaded DLL; its function at +8 fills +0xd onwards
fields.axisNames: what a binding cell shows; empty or '*'-prefixed axes are skipped
fields.buttonNames: what a binding cell shows; '*'-prefixed buttons cannot be bound

fields.leftClicked: mouse_update: 1 on the frame the left button goes down; mouse_left_clicked returns it
fields.rightClicked: the same for the right button; mouse_right_clicked returns it
fields.middleClicked: the same for the middle button
fields.doubleClicked: mouse_update: 1 for a left click within 201 timer_read units of the previous one; mouse_double_clicked returns it
fields.lastClickTime: timer_read() at the last left click that was not a double click
fields.x: pointer x from mouse_read_state; every screen passes it to button_bar_hit
fields.leftDown: held now (the event handler's bit 0); mouse_update edges it into leftClicked
fields.rightDown: held now (bit 1); also shows the developer coordinate readout
fields.present: set by mouse_init when the driver reports a mouse; gates every driver call

fields.playerKillsEnemyMech: MW2 mech_on_destroyed: killCreditMech is the player, a mech, allegiance 1. The debriefing's 'Enemy Mechs Destroyed' DIRECT column
fields.shotsFired: MW2 mech_weapon_fire, once per shot by the player's mech with ammo left. Hit Percentage's divisor
fields.enemyMechHits: MW2 mech_apply_damage: damage credited to the player on an allegiance-1 mech. Hit Percentage's dividend
fields.enemyMechsDestroyed: MW2 mech_on_destroyed: every allegiance-1 mech destroyed, by anyone. The TOTAL column; 250 honor each
fields.wingmenDestroyed: MW2 mech_on_destroyed: a mech of the player's group destroyed (not ejected, which is +0x36). 'Wingman Deaths', -4000 honor each after a win
fields.playerKillsEnemyOther: MW2 mech_on_destroyed: the player killed an allegiance-1 NON-mech (vehicle, aircraft, target). 'Enemy Vehicles Destroyed' DIRECT column
fields.enemyOthersDestroyed: MW2 mech_on_destroyed: every allegiance-1 non-mech destroyed, by anyone. The vehicles TOTAL column; 125 honor each

fields.formation: formationNames[formation] in star_limits_show; the star screen steps it +1/-1
fields.selected: the member star_set_member edits when given index < 0
fields.maxMechs: printed as 'Maximum Mechs in current Star'
fields.memberCount: bounds star_files_write's loop and the mass sum; star_set_member drops the last member
fields.maxTonnage: the Keshik-defined maximum: star_set_member refuses a heavier chassis; printed too

fields.path: mpack_db_open copies the path here and fopens it
fields.file: the open stream; every reader seeks and reads it
fields.count: the archive's leading int32: the number of items
fields.entries: collection of 8-byte {offset, size}; every reader takes entry id - 1 and checks id against the collection's count

fields.textX: the centre x minus half the text width
fields.textY: the centre y minus half the font height
fields.pressed: message_box: 1 while the button is held down under the pointer; picks the button shape drawn

fields.handle: the open file every seek and read goes through
fields.inUse: project_file_open refuses while it is set and sets it; project_file_close clears it
fields.types: one slot per header type, by project_find_type's index
fields.name: the path project_file_open opened (strncpy 0x20); project_file_close clears it

fields.resumeState: prm_save's nextState; prm_load hands it to main as the screen state to resume (-3 quit)
fields.career: main's career variable: 0 Wolf, 1 Jade Falcon, 2 Trial of Grievance
fields.pilotAccepted: main's byte, stored zero-extended: 1 once screen_register's ACCEPT (or a double-click on an occupied slot) picks a pilot; screen_register clears it on entry and main clears it on the title screen and a fresh start. screen_career reads it: 0 plays aworgstr/ajfrgstr and goes straight to the register (0xc)
fields.currentStarIsPlayer: stars_save_to_prm: currentStar == &playerStar; stars_restore_from_prm sets currentStar back from it
fields.savedPlayerStar: playerStar, copied whole by stars_save_to_prm and back by stars_restore_from_prm
fields.grievanceScenario: screen_grievance's index into grievanceScenarios: it starts from this value (0 when entered from the title, state 8), steps it with a button and stores it back on leaving
fields.pilotSlot: currentPilot's index in pilotRegistry, -1 for none; prm_load turns it back into currentPilot
fields.commandLine: MW2.EXE's command line, which MECH2 spawns it with: prm_save's string + ' -b=' + the name at 0x8395c, then star_launch_prepare appends ' -of=<player formation>' and, with an opponent star, ' -oe=<its formation>'. prm_load cuts it at the first character <= ' '

fields.font: the DATABASE.MW2 font item; text_width measures with it
fields.drawFont: the same font again; every caller passes it to screen_draw_text
fields.height: vfx_font_height(font); shell_menu and message_box centre text on it
fields.driver: the video driver it was made for

fields.streamLength: set to bwdLength just before the file is written; MW2's ProjectItem.streamLength, where project_next_chunk stops
fields.maxChunkSize: the largest chunk appended (bwdMaxChunk); MW2's project_next_chunk raises system_error(0x2c) for any chunk larger than this, so it must be kept up to date
fields.chunks: REV, DTBL, then the file's own chunks (GPS, or instmap's BMPJ / BMID)

fields.objectiveCount: how many of objectives[] are filled: MW2 counts the listed ones. SHELL: bounds every loop over objectives
fields.startTime: MW2: the player's objective table's start time. No shell consumer read yet
fields.decidedAt: MW2: when the table's result was decided. No shell consumer read yet
fields.result: MW2: 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 time exceeded, 0 undecided. SHELL: advancement and promotion require 2; the NOHERCSALLOWED path overwrites it with 2 and another path with 3
fields.objectives: 48 x 0x34 fills the record exactly: MW2's objective table holds 48
